baseline.holdoutRule: The v1-v16 holdouts are regression cases. Existing 95% image-exactness, 90% confirmed-return recall and zero wrong-channel thresholds remain unchanged. Two fresh real photos were selected and pixel-reviewed after both production image transformations before model evaluation: an intact single plastic water bottle with its front label only (unknown eligibility, trial action), and a single glass beverage bottle (blue bin, no return action). A visibly dented plastic candidate was discarded before any model call because its damage truth was ambiguous. New holdouts must pass both channel and action assertions. They are developer-visible, frozen, non-adaptive checks, not sealed blind tests. Every complete run checks all sources for near duplicates at 0.995 before any model call.

invariants: Only containers carrying the BCRS Deposit Mark are eligible for a refund.
The refund is S$0.10 per eligible container.
Containers without the mark remain recyclable through blue bins or other recycling stations.
The scheme product-approval guide distinguishes the product barcode from the separate square 2D traceability code printed on some approved labels.
